action_items: (Optional) Recolor admin Top Products bar chart for contrast (currently black on dark card).

(Optional) Backend sets an httpOnly access_token cookie on login while CORS allow_credentials=False; cookie can never actually flow cross-origin from the frontend, so it's dead code. Cookie is only useful when same-origin. Not a bug but worth cleaning up.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~981 lines -- consider splitting into routers/modules (auth, cart, orders, admin, payments) as feature scope grows.

Guest identity is passed by client-supplied x-guest-id header with no validation -- anyone with a known guest_id can hijack that cart/wishlist/order. Acceptable for MVP guest flow but flag for future.
gen_order_number() picks a random 5-digit int with no uniqueness/retry logic -- collisions possible once volume grows; add unique index + retry.

Stock decrement in POST /orders is not transactional with cart/order insert -- concurrent orders on last unit can oversell (no atomic check-and-decrement). Consider findOneAndUpdate with stock>0 predicate.
Coupon used_count is incremented on order create but never decremented on cancel/refund.

'CORS_ORIGINS="*"' with allow_credentials=False is fine; but frontend still uses Bearer token from localStorage stored via jt_token (XSS risk). Consider migrating to same-origin httpOnly cookies later.
Admin PATCH /admin/products/{id} accepts arbitrary dict -- no schema validation, allows setting arbitrary fields; add Pydantic model.
